name: Stone of Controlling Earth Elementals

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Summon an Earth Elemental
powers.text: Magic action (once per dawn): summon an Earth Elemental, as if by Conjure Elemental; it obeys you while you concentrate, up to an hour.

summary: Once a day, summon an Earth Elemental that obeys you (Concentration, up to 1 hour).
text: While you are holding this stone, you can take a Magic action to summon an Earth Elemental. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the stone as possible, is friendly to you and your companions, and obeys your commands. It lasts as long as you maintain Concentration (as if concentrating on a spell), up to 1 hour. The stone can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
